-- DepthTrackState
interface DepthTrackState {
    readonly id: number;
    readonly observations: readonly {
        readonly viewId: number;
        readonly featureId: number;
        readonly pixel: readonly [
            number,
            number
        ];
    }[];
    readonly status: 'bearing-only' | 'estimating' | 'finite';
    readonly reason: 'translation-unavailable' | 'depth-unobservable' | 'joint-uncertainty-unavailable' | 'insufficient-observations' | 'uncertain-depth' | 'inconsistent-observations' | 'validated';
    readonly referenceViewId: number;
    readonly bearing: Float64Array;
    readonly bearingCovariance?: Float64Array;
    readonly bearingCovarianceConditionalOn?: 'fixed-intrinsics-anchor-observation' | 'joint-bundle-linearization';
    readonly estimate?: AnchoredInverseDepth;
    readonly covariance?: Float64Array;
    readonly inverseRange?: {
        readonly mean: number;
        readonly stddev?: number;
    };
    readonly maxErrorPx?: number;
}

-- InverseDepthBundleResult
interface InverseDepthBundleResult {
    readonly reconstruction: SparseReconstruction;
    readonly estimates: readonly (InverseDepthConstraint & {
        readonly covariance?: Float64Array;
        readonly bearingCovariance?: Float64Array;
        readonly informationDeferred?: true;
    })[];
    readonly uncertainty: {
        readonly poses: 'joint' | 'fixed-exterior';
        readonly intrinsics: 'joint-focal' | 'fixed';
        readonly anchorViewId: number;
        readonly scaleViewId: number;
        readonly observable: boolean;
        readonly approximation: 'local-robust-Gaussian';
    };
    readonly diagnostics: {
        readonly initialCost: number;
        readonly finalCost: number;
        readonly acceptedSteps: number;
        readonly observations: number;
        readonly cameraParameters: number;
        readonly backend: string;
        readonly measurementBatches?: number;
        readonly measurementBatchSize?: number;
        readonly linearSolver: 'dense' | 'sparse';
        readonly schurEntries: number;
        readonly factorEntries: number;
        readonly cameraCovarianceEntries: number;
        readonly pointCrossEntries: number;
        readonly denseEquivalentCrossEntries: number;
        readonly inputObservations: number;
        readonly deferredTrackIds: readonly number[];
    };
}

-- ShadeDevice
class ShadeDevice {
    private readonly onProgress;
    readonly backend: 'webgpu' | 'cpu';
    readonly fp64Flavor: 'float' | 'integer';
    readonly boundedSubmissions: boolean;
    readonly solverCheckpoints: boolean;
    readonly lost?: Promise<{
        message: string;
        reason: string;
        diagnostics: DeviceDiagnostics;
    }>;
    readonly maxModelsPerBatch: number;
    readonly maxDispatchesPerSubmission: number;
    readonly timeBudgetMs: number;
    readonly chunkTimingSamples: number;
    readonly workingBytes: number;
    readonly bindingBytes: number;
    readonly bufferBytes: number;
    readonly adapterLimits: boolean;
    readonly maxKernelElements: number;
    get maxWorkgroups(): number;
    readonly maxWorkgroupSize: number;
    readonly workgroupStorageBytes: number;
    private readonly shade;
    private readonly diagnosticTracker;
    private readonly active;
    private readonly activeF32Lengths;
    private readonly workingReclaimers;
    private reclaimingWorking;
    private readonly history;
    private readonly kernelRows;
    private kernelsDropped;
    private readonly warmed;
    occupancyFloors: boolean;
    private readonly gpuMsPerUnit;
    private readonly lowered;
    private readonly sinceTimed;
    private uploads;
    private downloads;
    private reads;
    private pendingReads;
    private readWaves;
    private snapshotBytes;
    private tail;
    private closing;
    private closed;
    private disposal?;
    private owned?;
    private constructor();
    static open(options?: ShadeDeviceOptions): Promise<ShadeDevice>;
    private times;
    private observe;
    private settled;
    get chunkRates(): Readonly<Record<string, ChunkRate>>;
    get kernelStatistics(): {
        rows: readonly KernelStatistic[];
        dropped: number;
    };
    get reports(): readonly ShadePlanReport[];
    get info(): DeviceInfo;
    get diagnostics(): DeviceDiagnostics;
    get statistics(): {
        liveBuffers: number;
        liveBytes: number;
        pooledBytes: number;
        allocations: number;
        reuses: number;
        applicationUploadBytes: number;
        applicationReadbackBytes: number;
        kernels: readonly KernelStatistic[];
        kernelsDropped: number;
        reads: number;
        readWaves: number;
        residentSnapshotBytes: number;
    };
    private allocateTyped;
    private collect;
    resetKernelStatistics(): void;
    private record;
    dispose(): Promise<void>;
}

-- ShadeDeviceOptions
interface ShadeDeviceOptions {
    readonly backend?: 'webgpu' | 'cpu';
    readonly gpuDevice?: object;
    readonly gpuTimestamps?: boolean;
    readonly adapterLimits?: boolean;
    readonly occupancyFloors?: boolean;
    readonly poolBytes?: number;
    readonly workingBytes?: number;
    readonly maxModelsPerBatch?: number;
    readonly boundedSubmissions?: boolean;
    readonly solverCheckpoints?: boolean;
    readonly maxDispatchesPerSubmission?: number;
    readonly fp64Flavor?: 'float' | 'integer' | 'auto';
    readonly onProgress?: (event: {
        kernel: string;
        phase: 'start' | 'complete';
    }) => void;
    readonly timeBudgetMs?: number;
    readonly chunkTimingSamples?: number;
}

-- ShadePlanReport

        readonly calls: readonly string[];

        readonly why?: string;

            number,
            number,
            number
        ])[];
        readonly gpuTime?: number;
        readonly indirect?: true;
    }[];
    readonly chunks?: Readonly<Record<string, ChunkRate>>;
}

    readonly refinementIterations?: number;
}

-- PnPResult
interface PnPResult {
    readonly pose: Pose;
    readonly inliers: Uint8Array;
    readonly inlierCount: number;
    readonly meanErrorPx: number;
    readonly iterations: number;
}

-- Pose
interface Pose {
    readonly R: Float64Array;
    readonly t: Float64Array;
}

-- PreVerifiedPair
interface PreVerifiedPair {
    readonly verified: PairMatches;
    readonly verification: PairVerification;
    readonly geometry?: ImagePairGeometry;
    readonly rejected?: boolean;
}

-- ReconstructionTracking
interface ReconstructionTracking {
    readonly pairs: readonly PairMatches[];
    readonly rotations: readonly PairRotationEvidence[];
    readonly tracks: readonly FeatureTrack[];
    readonly untriangulatedTrackIds: readonly number[];
    readonly depthDeferredTrackIds?: readonly number[];
}

-- RegisteredView
interface RegisteredView {
    readonly id: number;
    readonly camera: Camera;
    readonly pose: Pose;
}

-- RelativeRotationOptions
interface RelativeRotationOptions {
    readonly iterations?: number;
    readonly maxErrorPx?: number;
    readonly confidence?: number;
    readonly minInliers?: number;
    readonly minInlierRatio?: number;
    readonly minSpreadDeg?: number;
    readonly seed?: number;
}

-- RelativeRotationResult
interface RelativeRotationResult {
    readonly R: Float64Array;
    readonly inlierRows: Uint32Array;
    readonly invertibleCount: number;
    readonly meanReprojectionErrorPx: number;
    readonly spreadDeg: readonly [
        number,
        number
    ];
    readonly translation: 'unobservable';
    readonly depth: 'not-estimated';
}

-- SparseReconstruction
interface SparseReconstruction {
    readonly views: readonly RegisteredView[];
    readonly landmarks: readonly Landmark[];
}

-- TrackTriangulation
interface TrackTriangulation {
    readonly xyz: Float64Array;
    readonly inliers: Uint8Array;
    readonly maxAngleDeg: number;
    readonly meanErrorPx: number;
}

-- TriangulationObservation
interface TriangulationObservation {
    readonly camera: Camera;
    readonly pose: Pose;
    readonly pixel: Pixel;
}

-- TsdfPhase
type TsdfPhase = 'allocate' | 'assign' | 'integrate' | 'carve' | 'count' | 'extract' | 'readback' | 'sort';

-- TsdfProgress
interface TsdfProgress {
    readonly phase: TsdfPhase;
    readonly pass: number;
    readonly passes: number;
    readonly view: number;
    readonly views: number;
    readonly done: number;
    readonly total: number;
    readonly phaseDone?: number;
    readonly phaseTotal?: number;
    readonly points: number;
}

-- TsdfUploadWindowReport
interface TsdfUploadWindowReport {
    readonly limitBytes: number;
    readonly peakSubmittedBytes: number;
    readonly drainCount: number;
}

-- TwoViewOptions
interface TwoViewOptions {
    readonly separateDirectionalObservations?: boolean;
    readonly iterations?: number;
    readonly threshold?: number;
    readonly seed?: number;
    readonly confidence?: number;
    readonly minIterations?: number;
    readonly refinementIterations?: number;
    readonly huberPx?: number;
    readonly minParallaxDeg?: number;
    readonly maxReprojectionErrorPx?: number;
}

-- TwoViewResult
interface TwoViewResult {
    readonly diagnostics: {
        readonly ransacIterations: number;
        readonly refinementApplied: boolean;
        readonly directionCompatibleCount?: number;
        readonly medianParallaxDeg: number;
        readonly meanReprojectionErrorBeforePx: number;
        readonly meanReprojectionErrorAfterPx: number;
    };
    readonly validPoints: Uint8Array;
    readonly E: Float64Array;
    readonly R: Float64Array;
    readonly t: Float64Array;
    readonly inliers: Uint8Array;
    readonly points: Float64Array;
    readonly inlierCount: number;
    readonly positiveDepthCount: number;
    readonly meanReprojectionErrorPx: number;
}

-- createKltPairCache
function createKltPairCache(device: ShadeDevice, options?: KltPairCacheOptions): KltPairCache;
